queries.query: all indexed fields fulltext = Lake Balanan

interpretation: Both bounded text searches returned only non-fish classes. A portal record for a historical CAS herpetology specimen independently demonstrates the exact locality phrase is used in iDigBio, but no fish record appeared in the reviewed query sets. This is not a fish-absence result or an exhaustive survey.
dataStatus: The iDigBio portal announced that its records stopped being updated on 2026-05-08, while its API was expected to remain operational through 2026. These queries are a frozen discovery screen, not current or complete collection coverage.
limitations: Text-query results only reflect the indexed locality/all-fields strings and the iDigBio data snapshot available on the check date.
Coordinate-only, differently spelled, unindexed and post-snapshot specimens were not evaluated.
Records from different collection providers may be mirrored or duplicated; no row-level cross-provider reconciliation was performed because no fish row was found.
No fish names, occurrence records, coordinates, geometry, diet, safety alert or public app row was added.
nextActions: Continue searches of primary university, BFAR and protected-area sources for an actual Lake Balanan fish assemblage or voucher list.
Treat any future nearby coordinates as candidate discovery only until the source locality, receiving waterbody and coordinate uncertainty are independently verified.
Do not convert this zero-fish text search into a lake absence claim.
